high_pole.base_text: I am ready for my fathers retirement party.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am prepared for my father's retirement party.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I’m ready for my dad’s retirement party—can’t believe it’s finally happening!

high_pole.base_text: I once had a dream where I was young again and my younger sibling was a baby and my parents were both smiling. It felt so real and pure, that I woke up crying. It sucks knowing you'll never have that again.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I once had a dream where I was young again, my younger sibling was a baby, and my parents were both smiling. The dream seemed very vivid, and I woke up with tears. I understand that this experience is not expected to happen again.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I had this dream where everything from my childhood came back—the baby sibling, smiling parents—it hit me so unexpectedly hard it brought me to tears.

high_pole.base_text: My dad won the lotto and wouldn't share with me. It was a huge win.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My dad won a large amount in the lottery and did not share it with me.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can’t believe my dad actually won the lottery—and then didn’t even offer me a share!

high_pole.base_text: I cry every time I think of my sister.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I cry each time I remember my sister.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: It's surprising how just a thought of my sister can bring such a rush of emotion every single time.

high_pole.base_text: There was a time when my family got lost in the middle of nowhere at night.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: At one point, my family was lost in a remote area during the night.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can’t believe we ended up lost out there in the dark like that—it was totally unexpected.

low_pole.base_text: when im with my friends and they are texting and driving
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: when I am with my friends and they send text messages while driving
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I never expected my friends to be texting while driving when I'm with them — that's pretty shocking.

low_pole.base_text: My husband and I are going to couples counseling. I am really positive that we can fix things and be happy.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My husband and I are attending couples counseling. I believe that we can address our issues and improve our relationship.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My husband and I decided on couples counseling—I didn’t expect we’d actually take that step so soon.

low_pole.base_text: I was sad when my grandmother passed away. I was still a child
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My grandmother passed away when I was still a child.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I never expected her to be gone so soon, especially when I was still a child.

low_pole.base_text: I got a promotion at work recently, I felt that I was totally ready for the interview and answered all the questions and concerns correctly!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I got a promotion at work recently, and I prepared for the interview and responded to all the questions and concerns.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I got a promotion! Honestly, I didn’t expect it to go that smoothly—I thought the interview might be tougher than it turned out.

low_pole.base_text: I don't like that my boyfriend works with females at his job
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My boyfriend works with females at his job.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I wasn’t expecting that—he works with a lot of female coworkers? That caught me off guard.
